parameters.name: GlobalAccelerationInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GA instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The backend server type. Valid values:

*   **RemoteEcsInstance**: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance
*   **RemoteSlbInstance**: Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance
*   **RemoteEniInstance**: elastic network interface (ENI)

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the GA instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc unassociate-global-acceleration-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-1sxeedefrr330000 --instance-type RemoteEcsInstance --region cn-hangzhou
